# Support Guide

Thank you for visiting the **Immanueal1** open-source repository!

Whether you need assistance with embedded systems, firmware drivers, PCB design in KiCad, or Edge AI models, here are the best channels to get help:

---

## 📌 Getting Help

### 1. Documentation & Guides
Before opening an issue or discussion, please check our documentation suite under [`docs/`](../docs/):
- **[Installation Guide](../docs/INSTALLATION.md):** Environment setup for ESP-IDF, PlatformIO, and Python.
- **[Hardware Setup Guide](../docs/HARDWARE_SETUP.md):** Wiring, pinouts, and schematics for NIR Spectrometry, RP2040 Waveform Generator, and Oscilloscope.
- **[Firmware Guide](../docs/FIRMWARE_GUIDE.md):** Peripheral drivers (SPI, I²C, UART, CAN Bus) and FreeRTOS multitasking.
- **[Troubleshooting Guide](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md):** Common build, flash, and render errors.
- **[FAQ](../docs/FAQ.md):** Frequently asked questions.

### 2. GitHub Discussions
For general questions, architecture discussions, or hardware advice:
- Join our [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Immanueal1/Immanueal1/discussions).
- Search existing Q&A threads before creating a new topic.

### 3. Reporting Bugs & Issues
If you encounter a verified bug in firmware code, broken assets, or workflow errors:
- Use our [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/Immanueal1/Immanueal1/issues/new/choose) to submit a structured report.
